title: Michael Penix Jr. injured late vs. Ravens after big hit; Tua Tagovailoa throws OT interception his place to seal Baltimore's comeback win over Falcons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Michael Penix Jr. injured late vs. Ravens after big hit; Tua Tagovailoa throws OT interception his place to seal Baltimore's comeback win over Falcons
sources.description: Michael Penix Jr. took a big hit toward the end of regulation and wasn't able to play in overtime of Sunday's loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
